ch.attract: Jellyfish swarm detected. Can you defend the power plant? Touch the screen to take control.
ch.intro: Operator, a swarm of two thousand five hundred jellyfish is heading for the power plant's cooling water intake. You have sixty seconds. Keep all four units online.
ch.go: Swarm incoming. Curtain at full air. Good luck.
ch.section: Section failure! There is a gap in the curtain. Close it now.
ch.blower: Two blowers have tripped. Air pressure is falling. Restart the blowers.
ch.curtain: Power dip! The whole curtain is down. Restore it now.
ch.sea: Waves above two metres. Your call: what do the boats do?
ch.camera: The AI camera is offline. Do you keep the curtain running?
ch.deep: The swarm is swimming deep. Boost the air.
ch.alarm: Intake alarm. Jellyfish on the screens. A unit is going offline.
ch.end: Time! The swarm has been held. Here is your score.
ch.top: New top score. You are on the leaderboard.
ch.op_normal: A normal day at the power plant. Seawater flows through this channel to cool its four units. The bubble curtain is on standby: no air, no cost.
ch.op_detect: Offshore monitoring reports a jellyfish swarm, fifteen kilometres north-north-west of the intake. Qandeel starts here, the moment the warning comes in.
ch.op_forecast: The drift planner runs four hundred forecasts using real currents and wind. There is a forty-four percent chance the swarm reaches the intake. The earliest jellyfish could arrive in about sixteen hours.
ch.op_curtain: So, three hours before the earliest arrival, the curtain switches on. The blowers start, and a wall of bubbles rises across the nine hundred and sixty-seven metre mouth, one section at a time.
ch.op_arrive: Sixteen hours after the warning, the swarm arrives. The rising bubbles drive a surface current back out to sea, and the jellyfish are held outside the mouth.
ch.op_collect: A workboat closes a floating boom around the held swarm, gathers it into a closed bag, and tows it three kilometres away, where the jellyfish are released alive.
ch.op_clear: All clear. The swarm was held at sea, the plant stayed at full power, and the curtain goes back to standby.
ch.op_without: Now the same swarm, without the curtain. The jellyfish reach the cooling water screens, and the units have to come offline.
ch.op_aicam_confirm: The AI camera on the breakwater confirms it: Blue Blubber at the mouth, right on time.
ch.op_aicam_early: Nine hours after the warning, earlier than forecast, the AI camera on the breakwater spots Blue Blubber at the mouth. The curtain was not due on for another four hours.
ch.op_emergency: The camera alarm starts the curtain at once. All ten sections open together and the blowers run up to full air. A few jellyfish slip in before the bubble wall is complete. The intake screens catch them, and the rest of the swarm is held at sea.
ch.op_early_clear: All clear. The swarm came early, but the AI camera caught it in time, and the plant stayed online.
ch.op_choose: Choose a case: the swarm arrives as forecast, or it arrives early, before the curtain is on.
